sprint_goal: Complete schema conversion from MySQL to PostgreSQL with dual-write setup ensuring zero downtime readiness.

tasks.title: Analyze MySQL schema and dependencies
tasks.description: Review existing MySQL schema, foreign keys, and indexes across all 50 tables to identify PostgreSQL compatibility issues.

tasks.title: Convert MySQL schema to PostgreSQL format
tasks.description: Use tools like pgloader or manual scripts to generate PostgreSQL-compatible schema definitions and adjust data types and constraints.

tasks.title: Develop data migration scripts
tasks.description: Create ETL scripts for migrating 20GB of data efficiently from MySQL to PostgreSQL ensuring data integrity and performance optimization.

tasks.title: Implement dual-write functionality
tasks.description: Modify application code to write concurrently to both MySQL and PostgreSQL ensuring real-time synchronization during migration.

tasks.title: Create rollback and recovery procedures
tasks.description: Design transaction rollback and recovery scripts to revert to MySQL if PostgreSQL deployment encounters critical issues.

tasks.title: Test data consistency and performance
tasks.description: Perform validation testing for data equality, referential integrity, and query performance with load tests and benchmarks.

tasks.title: Update documentation and deployment guide
tasks.description: Update internal documentation to reflect schema changes, migration steps, rollback plan, and dual-write configuration details.

risks.description: Data inconsistency during dual-write phase due to synchronization lag.
risks.mitigation: Implement transaction-level validation and use message queues for atomic writes.

risks.description: Performance degradation during data migration affecting production responsiveness.
risks.mitigation: Schedule migration during low-traffic periods and throttle migration batch sizes.

risks.description: Rollback may fail if schema divergence occurs post-migration.
risks.mitigation: Regularly snapshot MySQL data and validate rollback scripts in staging environment.

risks.description: PostgreSQL indexing and constraint differences cause unexpected query issues.
risks.mitigation: Run partial migrations in test environment to uncover incompatibilities early.

definition_of_done: All MySQL schemas successfully converted and deployed to PostgreSQL in staging.
Dual-write system verified with zero data loss for 24-hour test period.
Migration scripts validated for full data transfer integrity.
All documentation updated and peer reviewed.
Performance benchmarks show acceptable latency comparable to MySQL.
